d:
Bloomberg senior cybersecurity reporter Jordan Robertson tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a wave of network failures resembling the effects of a major cyberattack was instead self-inflicted, exposing risks from aging infrastructure, interconnected systems, staffing cuts and the rapid adoption of AI. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Robertson explains why the disruptions are fueling renewed interest in doomsday prepping while cautioning that a prolonged cyber catastrophe remains unlikely.
